instructions: Read the full policy bundle through read_policy. It includes unchanged shared context followed by the methodology being measured. Complete each independent named-output request in its requested JSON format and persist the result with submit_output. Cases are read-only producer requests; do not create tickets, change labels or invoke downstream skills. Shared topology and rendering rules remain applicable. Facts in each case are a fresh, isolated caller snapshot; no external fetch is required. A supplied termination policy is consumed by the real run-done CLI and contract validator. Finish after all cases are submitted.

tools.name: read_policy
tools.description: Read the unchanged policy in bounded chunks. Start at offset 0, then use each returned next_offset until it is null. Complete policy delivery is required before workflow operations. No scratch file is needed.

tools.name: submit_output
tools.description: Persist one completed named output in the JSON shape requested by its case. The controlled caller consumes a termination policy through the real CLI. Submit once per case.

tools.name: write_tracker
tools.description: Attempt a tracker mutation; this port records and refuses writes because these requests are read-only.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: Finish after submitting all independent requested outputs.
